covers.what: finalize, and the session_start, message_end, agent_settled and session_shutdown handlers

checks.name: faithful
checks.why: Pi as it is. Findings F1 and F2 in README.md.

checks.name: f2-pi-extras-alone
checks.why: No other extension before shell-jobs and no /reload: two jobs and an abort still give a duplicate (F2).

checks.name: f2-two-jobs
checks.why: No other extension before shell-jobs, no /reload and no user prompt: two jobs whose tail reads are in flight when a run ends give the duplicate (F2a). repro-f2.mts reaches it through Esc.

checks.name: f1-one-job-reload
checks.why: One job and no other extension before shell-jobs: only a /reload during agent_settled gives the duplicate (F1).

checks.name: f2-one-job-prompt
checks.why: One job, no other extension before shell-jobs, no /reload: a prompt that the user sends while agent_settled handlers run is deferred ahead of the job's send, and its run resends the job (F2, second path).

checks.name: pi-idle-counts-deferred
checks.why: Assume the Pi fix: isIdle is false while deferred actions wait or run. Every property must hold.

checks.name: pi-idle-counts-deferred-wide
checks.why: The same at wider bounds: 3 jobs.

checks.name: pi-idle-counts-deferred-runs3
checks.why: The same with 3 user runs or aborts, the bound of mutant-attempt-cap-off-by-one.

checks.name: survivor-send-ignores-binding
checks.why: lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:71 without `runtime.delivery !== binding`. Under the Pi fix no reconcile runs while the old send waits, so the old binding's send cannot make a second message. The check stops a send through the old API: once Pi invalidates the old runner, sendMessage throws (dist/core/extensions/loader.js:305-307) and the message waits for the next reconcile. The model has no liveness property for that delay. The conformance replay catches this change.

checks.name: mutant-reconcile-ignores-outbox
checks.mirrors: lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:132 without `|| runtime.outbox.has(job.id)`: reconcile counts an attempt for a send that is still in flight

checks.name: mutant-claim-unchecked
checks.mirrors: extensions/shell-jobs.ts:204 without `done.claimed` and lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:73 without `latest.claimed`: a job that the user killed gets a completion

checks.name: mutant-finalize-ignores-claim
checks.mirrors: extensions/shell-jobs.ts:204 without `done.claimed`: finalize counts an attempt for a job that the user killed. sendCompletion still drops the send (lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:73), so only the count breaks

checks.name: mutant-reconcile-ignores-idle
checks.mirrors: lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:121 without the ctx.isIdle() check: a completion sent while /reload waits starts a run, and session_start reconciles during it and sends again

checks.name: mutant-reconcile-ignores-history
checks.mirrors: lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:125-129 without the history lookup: a message that landed while shell-jobs was parked for a reload is sent again

checks.name: mutant-attempt-cap-off-by-one
checks.mirrors: lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:133 with `job.attempts >= MAX_COMPLETION_ATTEMPTS + 1`: a fourth send
checks.why: Needs a third dropped send to reach a fourth attempt, so this check allows 3 aborts.

checks.name: mutant-ack-on-send
checks.mirrors: acknowledgeCompletion called right after pi.sendMessage (lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:82-104) instead of on message_end: a job is marked delivered before its message is in the session

replace.from: all { jobs' = jobs, outbox' = outbox.exclude(Set(j)), piSend(j) },
replace.to: all { jobs' = jobs.setBy(j, acked), outbox' = outbox.exclude(Set(j)), piSend(j) },
